rows.label: tlk70000049_04_msg001
rows.name:
I was truly shocked when I heard the
king had fallen for a farmer's
daughter while away on campaign...

rows.label: tlk70000049_04_msg002
rows.name:
But nowadays, it seems to me
that precious few people think
much of that scandal.

rows.label: tlk70000049_04_msg003
rows.name:
Because Adel-sama lived among ordinary
people, he lacks the arrogance common
to royalty. That draws people to him.

rows.label: tlk70000049_04_msg004
rows.name:
Being liked by people is itself a
great source of strength.

rows.label: tlk70000049_04_msg005
rows.name:
Though even I never dreamed you would
one day lead a united army of soldiers
from many different nations.

rows.label: tlk70000049_04_msg006
rows.name:
Adel-sama may lead them, but keeping
such a diverse group together is a
truly demanding job.

rows.label: tlk70000049_04_msg007
rows.name:
I was only ever appointed to look
after Adel-sama in the first place.

rows.label: tlk70000049_04_msg008
rows.name:
Somehow that led to my watching over
Aletta in your absence, and lately
attending to the militia itself!

rows.label: tlk70000049_04_msg009
rows.name:
Sometimes I almost forget what my
actual job is supposed to be...
